raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: venn
  version: 0.1.3

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/venn-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1a30f9bc0a28806a6214bba3623a04fea498119c19e22a9d293b31e561aa2091

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - matplotlib-base
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - venn
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Venn diagrams for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 sets
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/venn/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hadim
